Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="application/pdf", uri="https://example.com/pdf/embedded_images_tables.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"pdf_options\":{\"extract_metadata\":true,\"hierarchy\":{\"enabled\":true,\"include_bbox\":true,\"k_clusters\":6}}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].pages)

asyncio.run(main())
```
